scheme_name: Fee Waiver Scheme For SC/ST Students Pursuing Higher Education
other_conditions: Must be born in Goa or have resided in Goa for at least fifteen years
Must have passed the qualifying examination from an institution located in Goa
Must be enrolled for the first year of a degree or postgraduate course
benefits_summary: Full waiver of tuition, library, laboratory and development fees for first‑year degree/PG students.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
Printed proforma of the application form
